packages.name: audioprep-contracts
packages.responsibility: Stable enums, value objects, error codes and cross-package protocols.

packages.name: audioprep-config
packages.responsibility: Configuration precedence, validation, redacted snapshots and capability switches.

packages.name: audioprep-store
packages.responsibility: SQLite schema, transactions, DAOs, reconciliation metadata and migrations.

packages.name: audioprep-artifacts
packages.responsibility: CAS byte storage, Artifact occurrences, strong references and garbage collection.

packages.name: audioprep-timeline
packages.responsibility: Integer-tick mappings, timebases and Manifest timeline semantics.

packages.name: audioprep-pipeline
packages.responsibility: NodeSpec, MediaPortSpec, predicates, Plan graph and fingerprints.

packages.name: audioprep-planner
packages.responsibility: Capability/resource snapshots, implementation selection and Plan sealing.

packages.name: audioprep-worker
packages.responsibility: Isolated process protocol, cancellation, timeout and result envelopes.

packages.name: audioprep-audio-io
packages.responsibility: Probe, decode, resample, QUALITY_MASTER and ANALYSIS_COPY production.

packages.name: audioprep-vad
packages.responsibility: Voice activity detection nodes and speech interval artifacts.

packages.name: audioprep-enhance
packages.responsibility: Optional denoise, separation and enhancement candidate nodes.

packages.name: audioprep-diarization
packages.responsibility: Optional speaker analysis and speaker-attributed facts.

packages.name: audioprep-asr-eval
packages.responsibility: Optional advisory transcription/metrics for user comparison; never an authoritative audio-quality verdict.

packages.name: audioprep-decisions
packages.responsibility: Candidate joins, policy evaluation and one-time Decision resolution.

packages.name: audioprep-review
packages.responsibility: Local audition/review contract, optional loopback adapter, compare-and-set resolution and event streaming.

packages.name: audioprep-delivery
packages.responsibility: Final rendering, Manifest validation, staging and atomic publication.

packages.name: audioprep-scheduler
packages.responsibility: Single-machine single-writer orchestration, dispatch, local resource leases, execution fences and reconciliation.

packages.name: audioprep-app
packages.responsibility: Host-facing Context lifecycle and Public API v1 facade.
